title: UPL Sp 16 sweet potato (SG 08 19 01): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: UPL Sp 16 sweet potato: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: UPL Sp 16 sweet potato is a sweet potato variety. 105 to 120 days to harvest, 14.1 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: UPL Sp 16 is a registered sweet potato variety, also sold or known as SG 08 19 01. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 2016 as NSIC 2016 Sp37. It takes 105 to 120 days from planting to harvest, with 14.11 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: If you came here looking for SG 08 19 01, this is the same sweet potato. The facts below come from the NSIC registry kept by the Bureau of Plant Industry. Compare it with the others in our [sweet potato variety finder](/crop-varieties/sweet-potato), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for root crops](/land-preparation/root-crop-land-preparation).

items: **Days to harvest:** 105 to 120 days from planting to harvest.
**Yield:** 14.11 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about UPL Sp 16 sweet potato
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

UPL Sp 16 sweet potato takes 105 to 120 days from planting to harvest. That is about the average of the 26 sweet potato varieties with a day count, 114.5 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 14.11 t/ha trails the average of its group, 15.15. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions
rows: Took some damage but held up

blocks.text: It was weak against weevil, so scout for it from the early weeks.

The pests and diseases that hit sweet potato fields most often: [root knot nematode](/diseases/root-knot-nematode). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

Its roots have light yellow flesh and intermediate pink skin. Dry matter is 31.12 percent. A higher dry matter cooks mealy and gives processors more flour or starch from each tonne. The starch content is 59.62 percent.
Where and when to plant UPL Sp 16 sweet potato
Pick by use and market: yellow or orange flesh for snacks and fries, purple for processing, white for boiling. Weevils are the main enemy, so plant clean cuttings and harvest on time.

items.q: Is SG 08 19 01 the same as UPL Sp 16?
items.a: Yes. SG 08 19 01 is another name for UPL Sp 16, registered as NSIC 2016 Sp37. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 105 to 120 days from planting to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 14.11 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of UPL Sp 16?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
